t: A 3D-printable humanoid robot torso for schools and makers.
steps: Download the free STL print files and checklists from the pib.rocks build page.
Buy the non-printable parts box from the pib shop or gather the parts from the bill of materials.
Print the parts in PLA on a 3D printer.
Assemble the robot by following the build guide and printing checklists.
Flash Raspberry Pi OS to a microSD card and run the setup-pib script.
Open the Cerebra web interface from a browser on the same network.
Try a Blockly program that moves one arm.
